parsed_json.up: Identify compounds with exact IC50 measurements (standard_relation = '=', standard_units = 'nM') satisfying: IC50 < 50 nM against target CHEMBL2971 (JAK2) AND IC50 > 200 nM against target CHEMBL2835 (JAK1). Compute the result by intersecting the two target-specific compound sets or by deduplicating each target-specific hit set before joining, ensuring one row per qualifying compound. Return only the columns compound_chembl_id (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id) and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id then canonical_smiles.
